title: MV Looking for some help with a Moghunter plugin

posts.author: Teapartea
posts.body:
Hello! So I'd like to preface this by bringing up the plugin in question, Moghunter's Battle Hud. Generally, it works perfectly for what I am going for however with a glaring issue, being the images used for each actor.
One mechanic I am planning on including involves having the lead player character's design changing depending on their class; however the issue generally lays in how Moghunter's Battle Hud contains no script calls or plugin commands for changing the images used for an actor. Part of this is likely because it seems to operate more so on the corresponding ID used for said actor, but I'm curious to see if there are any solutions to this that I should look into. Perhaps if there is a similar script out there that can achieve a similar effect to Moghunter's Battle Hud, as well as the desired commands, that could be worth it. Or if there's anything I could use outside of that, that would be cool too! Either way, I'd appreciate some insight on the matter.

I probably should have clarified, the image file used for the actors in question exists outside of the standard default actor images used in MV itself. I went and took a screenshot from the Moghunter demo project and circled what I was referring to in red to provide a better idea of what I was talking about.
The image files themselves are taken from a sprite sheet found in img/battlehud, and typically are named "Face_[actor ID]". These images are what I'm wanting to look into finding a method of changing depending on changes bought to a party member through the events of the game itself.
As for the class changing, while I can just use the typical RPG Maker command for that, I also want to bring in a separate class leveling system akin to Xenoblade Chronicles 3. I already know a few plugins that accomplish this idea, however since Moghunter's plugins often operate within their own image folders and just are generally separate from other plugins I do not see any class changing plugins being able to change the image files used for an actor with the battle hud unless maybe if they were specifically made to do just that. But at the end of the day, I'm not particularly an expert on the specifics here, this is just what I understand from my own outside perspective here.

When you share error messages, you want to show the error trace from the console tab of the devtools window. Press f12 while the game is open and it should bring it up. among other things, it tells you the exact line that generates the error and is more helpful than the default error massage the game generates.
Theres an immediate issue here that causes the error that you saw, and a second one that may or may not be lying in wait after you fix it. ill bring up both
The first one is exactly as the error says. for actors, _actorId() is not a function. the property is _actorId, and the function to get their id is actorId(). using either one works, but _actorId() doesnt exist. if you noticed, the code i gave you uses .actorId(), but moghunter's code usually uses ._actorId. in most circumstances the difference doesnt matter.
the second problem that may or may not be an issue...
Teapartea said:
if ($gameTemp._ougiData[1].isActor()) {
Click to expand...
so, from this we know that ougiData is an array and index 1 is a battler. the original code never references an _actor, a _battler, or some other similar property in itself like the others did. it uses ougiData[1] instead. That combined with Scene_Battle not having those properties defined in the base code either means its likely the case that this._actor doesnt exist and youll get a crash the second your code gets to this._actor.currentClass().id from trying to read currentClass of undefined
if that happens, your next move is to change any any reference you make to this._actor to $gameTemp._ougiData[1] instead.
